Private wire pin: `7ad86d7acc1234e446cacb61c8e7f00b4bf989ab`, `packages/contracts/action-authority-0.2/validate.mjs` (accepted source `1afbb5a53ebbf0eca9252b3b09ceb3e404918151`). Implement POST `/api/clio/application-authority/identity` with `{}` → `{principal:{tenantId,actorId},identityRevision,checkedAtMs,expiresAtMs}`; POST `/api/clio/application-authority/context` with `{identitySha256,conversationId,clientId}` → `{identitySha256,principal:{tenantId,actorId},identityRevision,conversationId,selectedClientId,contextRevision,checkedAtMs,expiresAtMs}`.

Existing capirov2 owners at `4be13b0b1ed0f2f3fa014040eedbb2fc2c27dace`: `apps/api/src/auth/clerk.service.ts:77` (verified claims), `:69` (existing backend client), `apps/api/src/tenant/tenant-context.middleware.ts:111` (verified principal/current membership), `apps/api/src/meri/meri.service.ts:873` (active owned conversation), `:955` (nonarchived client), and `apps/api/src/context/context-security-scope.service.ts:27` (current ethical walls). Reuse these owners; require an existing matching nonnull conversation client. Actor is backend TenantContext.userId. No browser scope or Meri run/fence/grant/approval authority is admitted.

Pinned `@clerk/backend@1.34.0` supports the narrow online read `clerkService.backend.sessions.getSession(verifiedClaims.sid)` → GET session by ID. Verify signed sid/subject against returned session/user, require active status and unexpired original bounds, and fail closed on absence, mismatch, revocation, expiry, outage or timeout. No session/token mutation, refresh or creation. Preserve stable security-relevant revisions, excluding activity timestamps. Existing signed token without sid must refuse; no template or token-flow change is authorized by this request.

Reuse the existing Capiro backend client and server key only; never copy the key into Meri/frontend. No new credential, permission, role or network expansion is requested. If current access cannot do the read, report it rather than expanding scope. Exact SDK source/metadata and interface limits: https://github.com/neo-capiro/meri-greenfield/blob/a83a48c54b8f4bb6101493ca1343e8c376ce910c/docs/coordination/reports/CODEX-CAPIRO-CLERK-SESSION-READ-20261013.md . Full active-conversation/context request: https://github.com/neo-capiro/meri-greenfield/blob/7ad86d7acc1234e446cacb61c8e7f00b4bf989ab/docs/coordination/reports/CODEX-CAPIRO-APPLICATION-AUTHORITY-REQUEST-20261013.md .

Meri client/context/mount source is independently accepted; 245/245 integrated checks and the actual two-listener synthetic HTTP flow pass. Real Capiro endpoints, admitted product currentRun and deployment remain separate. No live Clerk call or credential access occurred here.

Meri application mounting continuation published as https://github.com/neo-capiro/meri-greenfield/pull/47 . Exact source/evidence pin `7ad86d7acc1234e446cacb61c8e7f00b4bf989ab`; later `a83a48c54b8f4bb6101493ca1343e8c376ce910c` adds only the backend-owner Clerk interface supplement.

`createApplicationActionHost` now composes concrete fixed-route authority HTTP adapters, the server-prebound canonical currentRun join, opaque session issuance and the four action routes. Mounting recipe: https://github.com/neo-capiro/meri-greenfield/blob/7ad86d7acc1234e446cacb61c8e7f00b4bf989ab/apps/control/action-host/application-adapters/README.md . PR46's same-origin session bootstrap and public0.1.1 action receiver are unchanged: native credential only for session issuance; returned opaque credential for query/draft/prepare/execute; browser hints never grant scope or approval.

Root 245/245 plus separate two-listener loopback replay pass; explicit approval remains mandatory, same proposal replay has no extra effect, revocation returns401. These are isolated synthetic authority/run/source/persistence tests, not live identity or browser deployment. Capiro's exact endpoint implementation request and the required existing-credential Clerk session read are in PR47; parent is relaying to that owner. A real admitted Meri currentRun owner is still required. No frontend source edits, new credentials, permissions or source activation occurred in this lane.
